description: Recent updates on Liga 1 include the first week schedule featuring Arema vs Isen Mulang FC and fan support for Persija.

sections.heading: Liga 1 Super League Schedule
paragraphs: According to ANTARA News Megapolitan, the schedule for the first week of the Liga 1 Super League has been released. A match between Arema and Isen Mulang FC is set to occur on September 4, 2026.

sections.heading: Supporter Concerns for Persija vs Persib
paragraphs: JPNN.com reports that The Jakmania is urging for the Persija vs Persib match to remain in Jakarta. The group expressed concerns that moving the match to other regions could lead to clashes between supporters.

sections.heading: Persija's Season Targets
paragraphs: According to Kompas.com, there is full support being given to Persija. This support aims to help the team realize high targets for the upcoming season.

faq.q: When is the Arema vs Isen Mulang FC match scheduled?
faq.a: According to ANTARA News Megapolitan, the match is scheduled for September 4, 2026, during the first week of the Liga 1 Super League.

faq.q: Why does The Jakmania want the Persija vs Persib match to stay in Jakarta?
faq.a: JPNN.com reports that The Jakmania is concerned about potential friction between supporters if the match is held outside of Jakarta.

faq.q: What is the reported support for Persija?
faq.a: Kompas.com notes that there is full support for Persija to achieve high targets in the next season.
